claims.evidence: The photo shows three solenoid valves, but it is not possible to confirm if they are original parts for a Honda Accord or a generic aftermarket part.
No Honda Accord model or part number is visible on the valves in the photos.
The valves show heavy rust and surface wear, which indicates they are used rather than new.

risks.risk: The valves may be non-functional or have internal leaks.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the electrical resistance of each valve and a hydraulic pressure test.

risks.risk: The valve may be a generic aftermarket part rather than an original Honda part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number stamped on the valve body.

risks.risk: The valve may be missing the necessary mounting hardware (nuts, bolts, or seals).
risks.proof: A photo of the valve with all included hardware.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and part number.
Photo of the part number stamped on the valve body.
Video of the valves being tested for electrical and hydraulic function.
Photo of the valve with all included mounting hardware.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
